title: Mc-Glory
description: Mc-Glory S1 is a survival Minecraft server with PvP enabled, a rewards system, and optimized plugin support. The arena is currently closed.
body:
# Mc-Glory S1 | Survival Server

**A classic survival Minecraft server for players who enjoy building, grinding, and PvP – with fair rules and an active community.**

---

## 🎯 Server Overview

Mc-Glory S1 is a survival server where you can explore, gather resources, build your base, and fight other players. It is designed to be challenging but balanced, with no pay-to-win mechanics.

### 🌍 Core Features

- **Survival Gameplay** – Full vanilla survival with minor quality-of-life improvements.
- **PvP Enabled** – Fight other players in the wild; safe zones exist near spawn.
- **Rewards System** – Earn rewards for playing, voting, or completing challenges.
- **Arena (Currently Closed)** – A dedicated PvP arena will open soon.
- **Optimized Plugin / Mod Support** – The server runs smoothly with common client-side mods (minimaps, performance mods). No server-side mods required.
- **Active Community** – Join a growing group of players who enjoy survival together.

---

## 📜 Server Rules

**Please read carefully. Violations will result in penalties.**

### 1. General Conduct
- No cursing, insulting, or harassment.
- No impersonating any known player (by name or skin).
- No advertising or even mentioning other servers.

### 2. Cheating & Unfair Advantages
- **No cheating mods, add-ons, or resource packs** that give an unfair advantage.
- **No auto-clickers, auto-totem, or any automation.**
- **No crystal / anchor usage** in PvP arenas.
- No exploiting commands like `/sethome`, `/team sethome`, or `/team setwarp` to annoy or harm others.

### 3. Building & Land Claims
- Do not build within **500 blocks** of spawn or another player’s base without permission.
- **No griefing** (destroying others' builds).
- Maximum **20 villagers** per area – exceeding will result in deletion without compensation.
- Maximum **64 spawners** per area – exceeding will result in deletion without compensation.

### 4. Teams
- Maximum **6 players per team**.
- **No alliances** between teams.

### 5. PvP & Conflicts
- PvP and stealing resources are allowed within server rules. Protecting your belongings is your responsibility.
- **No stream sniping** (using a player’s live stream to gain in-game info).

### 6. Economy & Trading
- Do not sell trivial items or set excessive prices in the auction house.
- **No real-money trading (RMT)** for in-game items or services.

### 7. Teleport Trap (TpTrap) Rules
- Teleport is for **cooperation only** – using it to kill or ambush is forbidden.
- No spamming teleport requests.
- If someone teleports you to kill you, they will be banned immediately. Open a ticket.
- Regular PvP is allowed, but tricking via teleport is not.

---

## ⚠️ Important Notes

- Any attempt to bypass the spirit of these rules is considered a violation.
- Rules may be updated at any time. Check this channel periodically.
- **No cheating or hacked clients.** Any form of unfair advantage (X-ray, fly, speed, auto-clickers) is strictly banned.

---

## 🔌 How to Join

- **Server IP:** `mgcraft.mc-join.net`
- **Minecraft Version:** Java Edition 1.21+
- **Mods:** Not required, but client‑side performance mods (Sodium, Lithium) and minimaps are allowed.

> ⚠️ **Note:** This is a multiplayer server, For full rules and updates, visit our Discord or website.
discord.gg/mcglory

---

**Start your survival adventure today on Mc-Glory S1!**
